ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Business & Techn Consulting. Course restricted to Junior standing & above. Business & Technical Consulting is an applied study of business concepts and strategies as well as techniques of consulting. Students form consulting teams that work directly with a business client for 12 weeks of the semester on a project jointly defined by the client and the team. The experience gained in this class is an outstanding addition to a resume. This course meets with IE 498, JMK, and is the same as BADM 445, which meets on a different evening.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
